submission_format: A single Python module named solution.py

evaluation.pass_rule: All correctness tests pass and the weighted score is at least 0.7

title: Build a RAG Retriever
summary: Build the retrieval half of a RAG system: chunking plus a TF-IDF cosine-similarity index.
requirements: chunk_text(text, chunk_size, overlap) splits into word chunks; raises ValueError if overlap >= chunk_size or chunk_size < 1
TfidfIndex.add(doc_id, text) and TfidfIndex.search(query, k) -> list of (doc_id, score), best first
Scores are cosine similarities of TF-IDF vectors with idf = log((1 + N) / (1 + df)) + 1
Search over 2,000 documents must answer in well under a second
description: Retrieval quality decides RAG quality. No embedding model is required: lexical TF-IDF retrieval is a strong, transparent baseline. Hidden tests check ranking on a labelled corpus.
